title: Confirm cancellation of edits

statement.en: Apply the documented Photo editing guidance to confirm cancellation of edits.
statement.ja: 「Photo editing」において「Confirm cancellation of edits」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Photo editing experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるPhoto editingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
